title: Max Temperature
statement: You are given an array of daily temperatures (integers, may be negative). Return the highest temperature. If the array is empty, return null.

answerKey.pattern: Single linear scan keeping a running maximum
keyPoints: Start the running max from the first element (or -Infinity)
Visit every element once and update the max when the current value is larger
Return the max at the end
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort and take the last element: O(n log n)

hints: What does sorting cost, and do you need the whole order to find one value?
Keep the best value seen so far while you walk through the array once.
Start the running maximum from the first element, and handle the empty array before the loop.
